ai_summary: Archean Chemical Industries Limited reported strong Q2FY27 consolidated revenue growth of 26% YoY, propelled by robust performance in Bromine and Bromine Derivatives segments, while strategically expanding into Silicon Carbide semiconductors and Zinc Bromide batteries. However, H1FY27 saw a consolidated EBITDA decline and standalone PAT contraction, primarily due to significantly higher material costs, increased operating expenses, and a doubling of finance costs. A notable increase in borrowings to fund ongoing projects also contributed to the increased financial leverage, which warrants careful monitoring.
